items.title: 初次见面
items.text: 要我报上名来？此行世间，我名号诸多，虽然随便一个对凡人来说都高不可及，但于我都已成过往。想称呼什么就随你吧，让我见识下你的品味，可别让我失望。
items.text_en: You want me to introduce myself? I've gone by many names and titles during my journey. Although each one is more eminent than any ordinary mortal could imagine, they're all just water under the bridge to me now.Call me whatever you like. Go ahead, let me see what you can come up with. Don't disappoint me.

items.title: 闲聊·风
items.text: 这世上没有纯粹的自由。风也会有吹到头的时候。
items.text_en: There's no such thing as pure freedom in this world. Even the wind cannot blow on forever.

items.title: 闲聊·说话方式
items.text: 我说话刻薄吗？只是实话实说罢了，接受不了的人才该自己反思原因。
items.text_en: You think I've got a sharp tongue? I just tell it like it is. If someone can't handle it, maybe that's their problem.

items.title: 闲聊·寒暄
items.text: 寒暄就免了吧，没话找话的样子也太可笑了。
items.text_en: There's no need to exchange pleasantries. It's rather pathetic to force a conversation just to occupy silence.

items.title: 下雨的时候
items.text: 想用我的斗笠遮雨？亏你提得出这种要求。
items.text_en: You want to use my hat as an umbrella? Hmph, the audacity to even make that request...

items.title: 雨过天晴
items.text: 见了点阳光就能高兴成这个样子？幼稚。
items.text_en: You're so happy just to see the sun again? How childish.

items.title: 打雷的时候
items.text: 啧…烦心。
items.text_en: Huh. How irritating.

items.title: 下雪的时候
items.text: 明明和雨没什么区别，却讨人喜欢多了…真是人各有命。
items.text_en: Fundamentally speaking, there's little difference between snow and rain, yet people lavish praise only upon the former... Fate can be truly arbitrary.

items.title: 刮大风了
items.text: 这点程度，你都能做到吧？
items.text_en: A simple breeze like this... Even you can conjure it, right?

items.title: 早上好
items.text: 「快醒醒——太阳要晒屁股咯——」…哈，你不会以为我会这么叫你起床吧？
items.text_en: "Rise and shine, sleepyhead, the sun's already in your eyes!" ...Haha, don't tell me you actually thought I'd wake you up like that?

items.title: 中午好
items.text: 我不需要吃饭。管好你自己和身边的小东西，就算是让我省心了。
items.text_en: I have no need for food. Save me the trouble and take care of yourself and that small thing floating next to you.

items.title: 晚上好
items.text: 终于，无聊的一天就要结束了。
items.text_en: Finally, another boring day is drawing to a close.

items.title: 晚安
items.text: 在我身边睡不着吗？呵呵。
items.text_en: What, can't fall asleep with me around? Hehe.

items.title: 关于流浪者自己·人偶
items.text: 烧掉一个人偶会留下灰烬。至于灰烬中会诞生什么…
items.text_en: A puppet consumed by a raging fire will leave behind ashes. As for what will emerge from them...

items.title: 关于流浪者自己·心
items.text: 那种东西随便了。执着于注定不属于自己的事物只是在浪费时间，现在的我有更重要的事情要做。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "Inversion of Genesis"I'll leave that kind of thing to fate. Obsessing over something that's destined to be ever out of one's reach is just a waste of time. I have more important things to attend to at the moment.

items.title: 关于我们·对手
items.text: 对你我以前的对峙耿耿于怀？哦。所以呢，你要怎么做？慢慢想，我不急。
items.text_en: So, you're still stewing over our run-ins from before? Huh. Well, what are you going to do about it? Take your time. I'm in no hurry.

items.title: 关于我们·同伙
items.text: 我不可能皈依「正义」，但既然说过要偿还你的恩情，就定会做到。倒是你，在和我接触的时候可能需要想想自己立场哦？万一被人撞见，说你与罪人「狼狈为奸」，我可概不负责。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Complete "Inversion of Genesis"I'll never be one of the good guys. I'm just here to pay my dues after what you've done for me.But what about you? Shouldn't you come up with some excuse for our meetings? If one of your friends mistakes you for collaborating with the enemy, you're on your own.

items.title: 关于「神之眼」
items.text: 所谓「神明的注视」令人不爽，但反正是可用的力量，我不挑。你觉得「风元素」有其深意？呵，为什么会这么想？神明行事蛮横又无理，我不是让你领教过吗？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "Inversion of Genesis"Although the idea of "divine favor" makes me a little ill, I'm not going to be picky about a new source of power. You think there's some kind of meaning behind the element of Anemo? Hah, why did that thought even occur to you? The gods aren't guided by any kind of rationality or moral compass. Haven't I shown that to you already?

items.title: 有什么想要分享
items.text: 没有。你想问什么就问吧，我看心情回答。
items.text_en: I've got nothing. Ask me anything you want. If a question is interesting enough, I may give you an answer.

items.title: 感兴趣的见闻
items.text: 看啊，鸟雀会炫耀羽毛，松鼠忙着囤积食物，人类为了柴米油盐整日奔走。头脑简单的生物活得就是比较容易呢。
items.text_en: Look. The birds are showing off their plumage, the squirrels are busy hoarding food, and humans are laboring for their livelihoods. Truly, simple animals don't need anything complicated to be fulfilled.

items.title: 关于小吉祥草王
items.text: 她选择不除掉我，或许不只是因为我有利用价值。也许是因为她很贤明，又有至善之心，又或许，是她在我身上看到了孤独的影子…你说我是在恶意揣测？哈，这不是当然的事情嘛！我又不是什么好人。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "Inversion of Genesis"While I still had value as a pawn, she might have had other reasons to keep me alive. It's certainly possible that it was because she's wise or benevolent, or happened to see a hint of loneliness within me... You think I'm trying to think the worst of her? Hah, did you really expect anything else? In case you've forgotten, I'm no saint.

items.title: 关于雷电将军
items.text: 对自己的造物视若不见，却又美其名曰不忍心干预…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4She completely neglected her own creation, and to add insult to injury, she said it was because she "couldn't bring herself to intervene" in my fate...

items.title: 关于「女皇」
items.text: 人人都称赞她的温柔与慈爱，却不知「爱」也是「罪」的一种。搞不好是代偿心理作祟哦？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Everyone praises her for her kindness and benevolence, but they forget that love is also a form of sin. What if she's just trying to compensate for something?

items.title: 关于「丑角」
items.text: 「丑角」是坎瑞亚的遗民——除此之外，我对他知之甚少，也从未与他有过什么密切的交流。但他似乎对我意有所求，以前给我指派过不少重要的任务，包括前往「深渊」。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4The Jester is a survivor of Khaenri'ah. Besides that singular fact, I know very little about him, and never had any kind of close association with him. He seems to want something from me, though. In the past, he assigned to me many important tasks, including a number of trips to the Abyss.

items.title: 关于「队长」
items.text: 「刚正不阿的『队长』」、「正直果敢的『队长』」、「战功累累的『队长』」…这些愚人众里流传的言论，就算是人偶的耳朵也要听出茧子来了。你不觉得，绝对的「正直」，其实是个极其危险的隐患吗？更不用提，「队长」拥有顶尖的实力。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4"The ever-righteous Captain," "the brave and fearless Captain," "the nigh-invincible Captain"... Even my mechanical ears demand maintenance after listening to so many compliments from the members of the Fatui. Don't you think that possessing absolute righteousness is actually a latent danger? And that's without taking his great personal strength into account.

items.title: 关于「博士」
items.text: 真遗憾，小吉祥草王让他消除了那么多的切片，剥夺了我将他一片一片千刀万剐的快乐。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "Inversion of Genesis"It's a pity that Lesser Lord Kusanali already forced him to erase so many of his segments. The joy I would have derived from slicing them apart one by one...

items.title: 关于「少女」
items.text: 试问：当遇到一名「无论何时」都懵懂无知，「无论做什么」都麻木平淡的「少女」时，该作何反应？我的话，尚可一战；你的话…因为太有良知，还是离她远些吧。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Let me ask: what should you do if you were to encounter a "damsel" who is oblivious and innocent at any given time, and unconcerned and unfeeling in any given situation? If it were me, I could at least challenge her to a fight. But if it were you... with your conscience, I would stay away from her.

items.title: 关于「仆人」
items.text: 道貌岸然的伪君子。她对人展露「优雅」与「亲切」都只是为了更好地「控制」罢了。而直面过她疯狂一面的人，大多已经…呼~。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4A wolf in sheep's clothing. To exert a higher level of control over people, she puts on a graceful and cordial front. Most of those who have seen her true, crazy self... have gone poof.

items.title: 关于「公鸡」
items.text: 也就是「公子」才会觉得「公鸡」是真心实意、不求回报地关心他和他的家人。虽然那位市长大人确实做了不少实事，但稍微有点脑子的人都能看出来，这里的潜台词是「你的家人都在我掌控之中」吧？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Only someone as dense as Childe would think The Rooster is looking after him and his family out of the goodness of his heart. Although the mayor has indeed done a number of things for their benefit, anyone with a brain would be able to tell that the underlying meaning is "your entire family is in my hands."

items.title: 关于「木偶」
items.text: 她除了自己的研究以外什么都不关心，性格恶劣得很。但即便做到如此极端的地步，却也只是制造了大量废品，在我仍是执行官时还低我一席，真是可怜。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4She has a terrible personality and cares for nothing outside of her own research. But even with that amount of dedication, she still produced a copious amount of garbage, and could only secure a ranking that's still one whole place beneath my own. How pitiful.

items.title: 关于「富人」
items.text: 那个第九席啊，他对「公平交易」过分偏执，甚至试图推翻神与人之间天生的不平等。不过凡人就是这样，容易有不切实际的妄想，倒也没什么特别的，就像他平庸的能力和眼光一样——选择和「博士」密切合作，哼，是不会有好下场的。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Oh, the ninth-ranked guy. He's obsessed with the idea of "fair exchange," to the point of wanting to overthrow the natural imbalance between gods and humans. But, I guess it's just how ordinary mortals are like — it's easy for them to come up with pointless delusions. Honestly, it's nothing worth writing home about, just like how there's also nothing impressive about his abilities or choice of partner. Hmph. Anyone who chooses to work closely with The Doctor is sure to meet a nasty end.

items.title: 关于「公子」
items.text: 头脑简单，四肢也不甚发达。让他做最后一席都是在拉低执行官的整体水准。万幸，我已经不在其列了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4He's simple of mind and not that strong of body. Naming him to the lowest-ranked seat lowered the Harbingers' collective prestige. Thankfully, I'm no longer part of that group.

items.title: 关于「女士」
items.text: 她的灰烬里什么都没有。我对失去未来的人不感兴趣。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "Omnipresence Over Mortals"Nothing remained in her ashes. I have no interest in those who have lost their future.

items.title: 关于八重神子
items.text: 油腔滑调的妖怪，为博神明的青睐，将自己伪装成关心人类的样子。其实，只是为了找乐子吧？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "Omnipresence Over Mortals"A smooth-talking youkai. Though she pretends to care about humans to gain the favor of her god, all she seeks are entertaining ways to pass her time.

items.title: 关于枫原万叶
items.text: 你说枫原家的后人？那岂不是…哦？他也有风元素的「神之眼」，还扛下过雷电将军的一刀？呵呵…哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "Inversion of Genesis"You speak of the descendant of the Kaedehara clan? Then isn't he... Wait, he also possesses an Anemo Vision? ...And even managed to take on the Raiden Shogun's Musou no Hitotachi? Hehe... Ahahahaha!

items.title: 想要了解流浪者·其一
items.text: 真稀奇，竟然想了解我。会招来麻烦哦？
items.text_en: You want to learn more about me? How ridiculous. Don't you know that's only asking for trouble?

items.title: 想要了解流浪者·其二
items.text: 啊，一定有很多、很多人想要找我清算前尘。无所谓，我来者不拒——或者说，还挺期待的呢。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 3Oh, I'm well aware that many, many people will want to seek me out and settle the grudges they've built against me in my past life. Fine by me — come one, come all, I say. As a matter of fact, I'm somewhat looking forward to it.

items.title: 想要了解流浪者·其三
items.text: 我曾以为成神便可摒弃无用的情感，现在不这么觉得了。至少「愤怒」，无论来自他人还是自我，都是方便使用的工具。怎么会有人永远不生气呢？难以想象，这种人就没有一点脾气吗？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "Inversion of Genesis"I once thought that deification would allow me to get rid of all of my pointless emotions, but I've since abandoned that view. Anger, whether it be from others or myself, is too convenient and useful as a tool.How can some people just never become angry? I find that impossible to even imagine. Do they just not have a single mean bone in their bodies?

items.title: 想要了解流浪者·其四
items.text: 在进入世界树时，我心中只有一个念头：希望自己从未来到这个世上。世界树回应了这个愿望，却没有带来我期盼的结果。这片土地的命运在捉弄它的囚徒方面一如往常。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "Inversion of Genesis"When I entered Irminsul, there was only one thought in my mind: I wish I'd never been born at all.Irminsul responded to my wish, but didn't bring me the outcome I desired. The fate of this world hasn't changed a single bit when it comes to playing cruel tricks on its prisoners.

items.title: 想要了解流浪者·其五
items.text: 你我有过交点，但终有一天会去往不同的地方。谁知道以后会发生什么呢？走着瞧吧。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "Inversion of Genesis"You and I have crossed paths in the past, but our journeys will eventually diverge. Who knows what will happen next? Let's just wait and see.

items.title: 流浪者的爱好
items.text: 爱好？那是闲人才有空琢磨的东西吧，我看起来像是没事做吗？
items.text_en: Hobbies? Those are for idle bodies who have the free time to think about such things. Do I look like I have any interest in distractions?

items.title: 流浪者的烦恼
items.text: 在想怎么才能把你甩掉，去胡作非为一番。——开玩笑的，你信了？
items.text_en: I'm trying to figure out a way to get rid of you so I can go commit atrocities. ...Wait, did you think I was being serious?

items.title: 喜欢的食物
items.text: 有茶吗？越苦越好，回味无穷。
items.text_en: Do you have some tea? The more bitter, the better. It leaves the most fascinating aftertaste.

items.title: 讨厌的食物
items.text: 腻腻歪歪的甜东西，牙齿都要被黏在一起了。你自己留着吧。
items.text_en: I'm no fan of Dango, or any other sticky sweets that make me feel like my teeth are fusing together. Keep them to yourself.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其一
items.text: 还行吧，算是你为数不多的优点了。
items.text_en: It's okay. Guess this is one of the few things you're good at.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其二
items.text: 不错，至少做出了能入口的食物。
items.text_en: Not bad. You actually made something edible.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其三
items.text: 想害我？难不成你笨到忘了我非凡胎？
items.text_en: You wanna poison me? Are you so dumb as to have forgotten that I'm not human?

items.title: 生日
items.text: 把手给我。…呵，别紧张啊，只是带你去高处看看而已。如何？应当是非凡的景色。感谢就免了，谢来谢去的没意思。
items.text_en: Give me your hand. Heh, there's no need to be nervous. I'm just taking you to a vantage point.How is it? The scenery here should be quite breathtaking. There's no need to thank me — I see little point in it.

items.title: 突破的感受·起
items.text: …看得出来，你尽力了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 1...I can see the great deal of effort you put forth.

items.title: 突破的感受·承
items.text: 风吹过来了…你做了什么？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 2The wind is blowing this way... What did you do?

items.title: 突破的感受·转
items.text: 给我力量，你不担心后果吗？…好吧。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 4You aren't worried about making me more powerful? ...Alright.

items.title: 突破的感受·合
items.text: 虽说我可以成为你的助力，但将我视作同伴仍是件危险的事情，希望你清楚自己在面对什么。若你不畏惧，便站到我身后吧。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 6Although I can be of help to you, seeing me as an ally is still a dangerous endeavor. I hope you understand what you're doing. If you still insist on continuing down this path, then let me lead the way.

items.title: 元素战技·其一
items.text: 风起！
items.text_en: The wind rises!

items.title: 元素战技·其二
items.text: 俯瞰凡尘！
items.text_en: Behold!

items.title: 元素战技·其三
items.text: 怒风腾天！
items.text_en: Squall and fury!

items.title: 元素爆发·其一
items.text: 不度蝼蚁！
items.text_en: Unsightly insects!

items.title: 元素爆发·其二
items.text: 鼠雀之辈！
items.text_en: Wretched vermin!

items.title: 元素爆发·其三
items.text: 叫大声点！
items.text_en: Cry louder!

items.title: 元素爆发·其四
items.text: 把头低下！
items.text_en: Bow your head!

items.title: 元素爆发·其五
items.text: 毫无自知之明！
items.text_en: Know your place!

items.title: 元素爆发·其六
items.text: 就凭你，也配直视我？
items.text_en: You dare to gaze upon me!?

items.title: 冲刺开始·其一
items.text: 风驰！
items.text_en: Surge forth!

items.title: 冲刺开始·其二
items.text: 疾风随行！
items.text_en: Upon the gale!

items.title: 冲刺开始·其三
items.text: …真慢。
items.text_en: ...Too slow.

items.title: 冲刺开始·其四
items.text: 没叫你跟着。
items.text_en: Quit following me!

items.title: 打开宝箱·其一
items.text: 多余。
items.text_en: Unnecessary.

items.title: 打开宝箱·其二
items.text: 啊？这你也要？
items.text_en: Hah, you even want this?

items.title: 打开宝箱·其三
items.text: 你自己拿着玩吧。
items.text_en: Take it and have fun.

items.title: 生命值低·其一
items.text: 习惯了。
items.text_en: I'm used to this.

items.title: 生命值低·其二
items.text: 不值一提。
items.text_en: Nothing worth mentioning.

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其一
items.text: 要你何用！
items.text_en: Why are you even here?

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其二
items.text: 也没指望你派上用场。
items.text_en: Worthless as expected.

items.title: 倒下·其一
items.text: 坠入…深渊…
items.text_en: Falling... into the abyss...

items.title: 倒下·其二
items.text: 皆为…徒劳…
items.text_en: Everything... was futile...

items.title: 倒下·其三
items.text: 罪业的报偿…
items.text_en: The price... for my sins...

items.title: 重受击·其一
items.text: 不过如此。
items.text_en: That's far enough.

items.title: 重受击·其二
items.text: …可笑。
items.text_en: ...How amusing.

items.title: 重受击·其三
items.text: …你死定了。
items.text_en: ...You're dead.

items.title: 重受击·其四
items.text: 等着求饶吧。
items.text_en: I'll have you beg for mercy.

items.title: 重受击·其五
items.text: 做好付出代价的准备。
items.text_en: Prepare yourself for punishment.

items.title: 加入队伍·其一
items.text: 没想到…叫我做什么？
items.text_en: Huh... What do you want from me?

items.title: 加入队伍·其二
items.text: 你最好有要事相求。
items.text_en: This had better be important.

items.title: 加入队伍·其三
items.text: 非我不可？…行吧，勉为其难。
items.text_en: Are you sure it has to be me? ...Fine, let's get this over with.
